subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and what secret-bearing handoff format is acceptable?
rationale: This would add new provider-auth and likely env/config surface around OAuth authorization material, which affects security posture and cannot be chosen safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved plugin-owned handoff that validates PKCE/state and minimizes callback URL exposure before documenting and testing it.

options.title: Accept Callback URL Env
options.body: Support an env callback import only with explicit validation, redaction, docs, and proof for logs, shells, CI, and support contexts.

options.title: Defer To Existing Flows
options.body: Keep API-key, browser/manual paste, device-code, and supported Codex access-token paths as the only setup surfaces for now.

recommendation.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved plugin-owned handoff that validates PKCE/state and minimizes callback URL exposure before documenting and testing it.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this account to both non-interactive provider setup and the OpenAI provider identity/auth surface involved in the decision.
